🇲🇽🇨🇳 <u>First Fruit of Shenzhen: A Chinese-Style Smart Hospital for Mexico</u>

The first concrete agreement from Sheinbaum's meeting with Xi Jinping is a smart hospital in Mexico, modeled on the 100-bed Shenzhen center she toured. Mexican doctors will train in China, Chinese specialists may come to Mexico, and cooperation will expand into science, energy, waste-to-power and water treatment, plus student exchanges. Sheinbaum clarified that "Xi made no particular request of Mexico, nor I of China." 2027 marks 55 years of diplomatic relations.

🇲🇽🎰 <u>Sheinbaum Moves to Regulate Online Casinos and Betting Ads</u>

Mexico's gambling law dates from 1947 and never contemplated digital betting. Asked by Contralínea, Sheinbaum said Segob already has a bill ready to regulate online casinos and their TV advertising. According to the 2025 national addiction survey, 3.9 million people bet in the past year, and 904,000 of them were minors aged 12 to 17. "What caught my attention during the World Cup was that the main ads were for digital betting. It's a problem that can generate addiction, mainly in children and young people."

🚨🇲🇽 <u>Days After Shaking Hands at APEC, Trump Readies New Tariffs, Mexico Included</u>

Washington is preparing a new round of tariffs on 16 trading partners, Mexico among them, under Section 301, the same tool it used against Japan in the 1980s. The pretext this time is "industrial overcapacity," and the move is meant to replace the tariffs the US Supreme Court struck down in February. The rate for Mexico hasn't been set, and Reuters says the timing could still change, but the threat lands while Mexico is still negotiating bilaterally to remove the tariffs already in place.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>Mexico Hands China a Four-Point Plan to Choke Off Fentanyl Precursors</u>

While Washington's ambassador trades accusations with Beijing on X, Mexico went to Beijing with a plan. At the third meeting of the Mexico–China Working Group on Chemical Precursors, the SRE proposed four priorities: regulatory control of chemicals, customs and supply-chain traceability, joint intelligence and interdiction, and action on clandestine labs with forensic analysis. Sedena, Semar, SSPC, customs agency ANAM and the SRE sat across from China's Public Security and Commerce ministries and its customs administration, about 30 officials in all. Both sides agreed to implement the plan.

🇲🇽💵 <u>Peso breaks 19 as the Fed hikes and Banxico cuts</u>

The peso fell nearly 4% between Wednesday and Friday, closing at 19.16 per dollar, its weakest level since June 2025. It has lost 13.5% since September 4.

El Financiero's Víctor Piz lists the drivers: war in the Middle East, doubts about the US AI boom, and a shrinking rate gap. The Fed raised rates in September and is hinting at more. Banxico cut to 6.25% on November 5 in a 3-2 vote. Dissenter Jonathan Heath warned that narrowing the gap "is not consistent with higher external rates and a volatile depreciation."

🔥🇲🇽 <u>Deutsche Bank budgeted $20M in penalties for rigging Mexican bonds. It paid $430K</u>

Leaked internal files from El Universal and CLIP show Germany's biggest bank set aside $20 million for penalties over the rigging of the secondary market for Mexican government bonds, a case it code-named "Project Pearl." By using COFECE's leniency program, it ended up paying just $430,000.

COFECE proved 142 collusive agreements from 2010 to 2013 by seven banks, BBVA, HSBC, Santander and Banamex among them. In New York, the banks have agreed to pay US pension funds $107.1 million. Nobody has said what the scheme cost Mexican workers' Afore retirement savings.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>Gorillaz frontman salutes Sheinbaum at Corona Capital</u>

In front of 72,000 people in Mexico City, Damon Albarn waved a Palestinian flag a fan handed him, then talked about the president who flew to the APEC summit in China in economy class: 21 hours on a commercial flight, with a stop in Tijuana.

"I love Mexico because you have a revolutionary spirit. It's an inspiring country. I don't know much about your president, but the fact that she traveled in economy class is something really important to me."

🇲🇽🇵🇸 <u>Francesca Albanese is coming to Mexico</u>

The UN Special Rapporteur on the occupied Palestinian territories will speak at UNAM on November 30, in the Aula Magna of the Faculty of Philosophy and Letters, invited by BDS México and the Organization of Academics with Palestine.

This is the jurist Washington sanctioned for documenting the genocide in Gaza. Days ago in Madrid she said it plainly: "There is no good Israel outside the settlements." Mexico's largest public university is giving her the floor.

🇲🇽✊ "It is much better to encourage each and every student than to separate them into those who supposedly have talent and those who don't." "They criticize us because we give a scholarship to each and every student. They say the scholarship should be only for those with good grades." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Well-being Scholarships event, Villanueva, Zacatecas, Nov 21, 2026 As Mexico City's head of government, Sheinbaum replaced the "Talented Children" scholarship, which went only to students with a 9–10 average, with a small one for every primary and secondary student. A study two years later found more children getting better grades. This year the universal secondary scholarship (Beca "Rita Cetina") brought 400,000 more young people into high school, and Zacatecas is the first state where every university student gets the "Gertrudis Bocanegra" scholarship.
